description:
From the fz-kdt.111 refutation (2026-09-01, e2fb695e5/788c0c21f). The
'provably absent at runtime' idea is now spelled several ways and split
across two conventions:

SPELLINGS in ir_interp/backend.rs: (1) the new BackendTail::Value arm
gates on return_layout.layout.reprs.is_empty(); (2) bind_delivered_value
(~:2313) on structural == Nothing && carrier == Absent; (3)
raw_lanes_for_shape_value (~:2530) on (Nothing, Absent).
reprs.is_empty() is the broadest (also true for a zero-capture direct
Callable and a zero-lane Tuple); instrumentation says the corpus only
exercises structural = Nothing today, so nothing diverges -- fold to one
named predicate before something does.

CONVENTIONS: the interp carries two contradictory encodings of absence
-- a MISSING env entry (demand-ignored inputs, deliberately kept: the
closure-call resolution reads a missing callee entry as
omitted-use-direct-target, and fz-kdt.111 measured that an explicit
Absent there regresses) vs an Absent BINDING (omitted constructions,
native.rs:1012 / ir_interp/backend.rs:1067). Only the first triggers the
missing_direct_callee fallback. Decide one convention or document the
split as load-bearing with the fz-kdt.111 measurement as the reason.

DUPLICATED SOURCE in jobs/backend.rs: executable_value_shapes (~:342)
recomputes value shapes from abi.transport.value_positions although
abi.value_layouts (what native reads via value_shape()) is on the same
struct -- NOT identical: jobs/artifact.rs:2178-2188 overrides clause
params with input.layout, which executable_value_shapes lacks. Harmless
today (a construction target is never a clause param; a corpus-wide
assertion proved agreement at every Lambda/FunctionRef) -- fold or
document the divergent override. Also: the FunctionRef half of the
omission is symmetric-but-unproven (zero corpus movers) -- a fixture
that exercises a dead FunctionRef would make it load-bearing.
title: One absence proof, one spelling: fold the interp's three absent-value predicates and the duplicated shape source
